report.summary: Both failures are the same test-side bug: the page object clicks a button with test id "add-books", but the app's button is "add-book", so Playwright times out before either test reaches its assertions. Fix the locator in tests/support/pages.py:44 first; the future-year test's own expectations are unverified until it gets past that click.

causes.title: BooksPage.add clicks a test id that does not exist in the app
causes.explanation: tests/support/pages.py:44 calls self.page.get_by_test_id("add-books").click(), but app/templates/books.html:9 renders the submit button as data-testid="add-book". The locator never matches, so Playwright waits 5000ms and raises TimeoutError. Both tests call books.add(...) and fail at that line before any product behaviour is exercised. The app markup is consistent with its other test ids and nothing in the app suggests the button should be renamed, so the test-side name is the wrong one.
evidence: tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:13 and :42 both call books.add(...) and fail at tests\support\pages.py:44
causes.suggested_fix: Change the locator in tests/support/pages.py:44 to get_by_test_id("add-book"). Then rerun both tests. Also check whether the future-year test's assertions (error text "Year must be between", title input keeps its value, no row created) match the app's real validation message, since they have not run yet.
